product_metadata.title: Cordless Vacuum Cleaner, Womow W18 2 in 1 Lightweight Handheld Stick Vacuum, 9000 pa Powerful Suction with LED Headlights for Hard Floors
features: 【9000PA POWERFUL SUCTION】: Womow W18 cordless stick vacuum cleaner utilizes a 150W high powered motor with 2 speed modes. The eco mode is suitable for picking up dog hair and dust on the hardwood floors while the Max mode provides efficient vacuum ability to clean embedded dust, debris, and crumbs
【LIGHTWEIGHT VACUUM CLEANER】: it only weighs 6lb, and is highly maneuverable, cleans under furniture easily and clearly with LED headlights. Slim body contributes to ease heavy work

【LONG BATTERY LIFE & QUICK CHARGE】: Built-in a 25.2V 2200mAh rechargeable Li-ion battery, the cordless vacuum cleaner only takes about 4 hours to be fully charged, up to 50 minutes on eco mode and 25 minutes on Max mode, allowing you to clean up your home with one single charge

【2 IN 1 HANDHELD VACUUM】: easily converts from a stick upright vacuum cleaner to a lightweight handheld vacuum for cleaning car, stairs, curtain, sofa, ceiling and other narrow gaps with a crevice tool

【What you get】 30-day money back and 12-months warranty; W18 cordless vacuum cleaner; crevice tool; charging stand. NOTE: Please empty the dust cup and clean the filter regularly to keep its best performance. For any questions, please contact us at any time. We will reply within hours
